body:
_Migrated from issue #1183, filed 2026-07-27._

Split out of #1180.

`E2E Tests (SPA)` is Layer 2 of the verification standard, but it currently cannot block anything:

1. `continue-on-error` on pull requests, so the job goes red while the run concludes `success`
2. the `Test Suite Summary` only warns (`echo "⛔ E2E tests failed - do not release!"`, no `exit 1`)
3. it is skipped on `main`

Net effect: rule-3 merge-gate condition (a), "every required CI check is green", kept passing with the e2e job failing inside the run. #1176 and #1177 merged through a red gate that had been red on every branch for a while.

#1180 fixes the fixture gap that made it red, and #1178 fixes the real mobile overflow it was correctly catching.

**Sequencing matters, so this is deliberately not part of #1180.** Promote only after several consecutive green runs:

- [ ] several consecutive green e2e runs on PRs
- [ ] drop `continue-on-error` for pull requests
- [ ] make `Test Suite Summary` `exit 1` on e2e failure
- [ ] run it on `main` (or on the `:dev` image build) so the release branch is covered
- [ ] mark it required in the branch ruleset

Making a gate mandatory before it is reliably green is how it got ignored in the first place. #1182 (sp1-ux flake) should land first — a known-flaky spec in a required gate would block merges at random.
title: Promote the SPA e2e gate to required once it has earned it
